name: Old Mutual plc
source: CRON 20261122: H1 2026 from the issuer unaudited condensed consolidated income statement, six months ended 30 June 2026, Old Mutual interim results booklet page 96, unit R million stored in absolute rand. Insurance group, no cost of sales, gross profit or single operating profit line printed, so those are honest dashes. Revenue 92460 is the sum of printed income lines: insurance revenue 37371, net investment return 44893, net finance income from reinsurance 135, non-insurance revenue and income 9787, share of associates 274. Operating Expenses 87761 is the printed expense lines (insurance service expenses 30927, reinsurance expenses 2359, net finance expenses from insurance contracts 23642, change in investment contract liabilities 10960, third-party interests in consolidated funds 5674, other operating and administrative 13388, loss on disposal 24) less the separately printed finance costs 415 and banking interest payable 165, which sit in Net Finance Costs 580. Revenue less Operating Expenses equals EBIT 4699 and EBIT less Net Finance Costs equals the printed profit before tax 4119. Income tax is stored negative because a tax credit of 89 was recognised; profit after tax 4208 ties, of which 3889 is attributable to equity holders of the parent. Basic EPS 95.8 cents. Sources https://www.oldmutual.com/om-docs/blt28ec918d074e226f/SENS_annoucement.pdf and https://oldmutual.com/v3/assets/bltdd392fd32dda3ce8/blt176bf29c4b878947/6a9fcad00b44f72a1c7ed8e9/2026_Interim_Results_Booklet.pdf || CRON 20261120_0440: bare alias and resolved statement unified from the same company's two copies. Period union taken; a blank rendered cell was filled from the alias only where the alias carried the value and its figures run at the same scale (unit guard). The resolved file's own value wins wherever the two disagreed, and every such disagreement is recorded in _alias_sync_20261120_0440.json. | Yahoo Finance | Yahoo Finance fundamentals (the feed the JSE pipeline already reads); merged into blank cells only, cross-checked against the file's own Revenue/Total Equity/CFO anchor | CRON 20261116: EPS row synchronised from the twin key OML, which carries the figures verified from the audited statements on 16 Nov 2026 (197.0c and 176.2c per page C1 of the FY2025 audited AFS on senspdf.jse.co.za, 158.4c and 115.5c from the FY2023 AFS, converted from cents to rand). Same company, same currency, same four periods, so the values are identical by definition, not re-derived.
